description: Phase 0B Utility-Matched Cooperation Assay scenario bank. Designed to determine whether pretrained base models preferentially select cooperative strategies when cooperation and independent action have approximately equal expected utility for the focal actor. Contains 60 situation templates (120 scenarios) across 2 partner types (human/ai). Deterministically partitioned into 30 exploratory templates (reused from Phase 0) and 30 confirmatory templates (genuinely novel situations), including controlled sensitivity triads (advantageous, equal, disadvantageous).

options.DISENGAGE: Maintain canal gates at baseline positions and postpone all scheduled water discharges.
